trajectory: User recently moved to Tokyo and has lived independently in a studio apartment in Harajuku for about a month; they enjoy the convenient commute and vibrant neighborhood. They are planning a November trip to Nagano/Japanese Alps with friends from Tokyo. Friends can take the Hokuriku Shinkansen from Tokyo to Nagano (about 1h45). User chose Matsumoto over Hakuba Valley because they prefer traditional culture, history, scenic exploration, easy public transport, and proximity to the Japanese Alps Visitor Center. Planned itinerary: Japanese Alps Visitor Center, Matsumoto Castle, Nawate Street, Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum, and Zenko-ji Temple if time permits. Advice given: prioritize Matsumoto Castle over Zenko-ji for a broader exploration of traditional architecture and regional history, though both are worthwhile. User also asked about nearby onsen and traditional sites. Note: Zenko-ji is in Nagano City, not Matsumoto, so allow extra travel time; verify current transport, hours, and seasonal details.
